msg.added: Added {id}. Change its settings under "Tracked" by clicking "Edit".

preview.not_created: This entity doesn't exist yet - it will be created on save; the first point appears at the next interval boundary.
preview.full_tooltip: Buffer is full - every new entry pushes out the oldest one (rolling window).
preview.timespan_tooltip: Current covered time span / maximum possible with this buffer size.
preview.no_entries_hint: No data yet - first write at the next interval boundary.
preview.not_enough_points: Not enough points for a chart (need at least 2).

form.offset_hint: e.g. -60 with a 1h interval = write at HH:59 instead of HH:00. 0 = exactly on the boundary.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.confirm_clear: Clear the buffered data for this entity? Tracking settings are kept - only the collected points are removed. This cannot be undone.
form.confirm_remove: Remove tracking and the entity {code}, including its buffered data? This cannot be undone.

settings.defaults_hint: Pre-fill the form the first time you track a new entity - can be overridden per entity.
settings.export_import_hint: Saves default settings and the list of tracked entities to a file - handy before a reset or Home Assistant migration. Does not include the history data itself (that lives in the entities and is unaffected).

add.search_placeholder: Search for an entity to track (name or entity_id)...
add.hint_choose: Type an entity name or pick a category to see entities you can add.

track.nothing: Nothing tracked yet - go to "Add" in the menu.
